Drafts

Nearest to your week

A lead writes while you’re up a ladder.

  • SkillLead Desk Every lead in one list, moved along by your mail.
  • RoutineLead Sweep Each morning, who answered, who is new and who went quiet.
  • SkillEmail Manager Drafts the reply. Nothing goes out until you press Send.

Chasing invoices is time you can’t bill.

  • SkillWaiting On Invoices never paid and replies that never came, with the chase drafted.
  • SkillMoney In & Out Log what came in and went out, then ask what’s left.
  • RoutineReceipt Sweep Once a week, the renewals you forgot you were paying.

Booking one estimate visit takes four emails.

  • SkillCalendar Manager Google, Outlook or iCloud. Proposes a move, makes it once you approve.
  • SkillFind a Time Drafts the reply that ends the back and forth.
  • RoutineToday’s Calendar One line per event, in your chat before the day starts.

You said Friday, and it’s Thursday night.

  • SkillCommitment Keeper Finds every “I’ll send that over” in your sent mail.
  • RoutineCommitment Sweep Every morning, what you promised and by when.
  • RoutineWeekly Review On Sunday, what got done, what’s open and what’s due.

The permit office’s email sits under ninety from suppliers.

  • SkillPaperwork Permits, licenses and forms, one step at a time.
  • SkillInbox Rules Say once what happens to each pile of mail.
  • RoutineInbox Sweep Your rules run every morning without you.

Every bill has its own site and due date.

  • SkillBills & Subscriptions Every repeat charge, with real dates.
  • RoutineBill Reminders A reminder three days before each bill.
  • SkillHome Maintenance Furnace filters, drains, gutters.
